overview: Atlas is a self-hosted personal travel tracker inspired by the Been app. It features a statistics dashboard showing countries visited, lived in, and wishlisted with continent progress, an interactive 3D globe, a US states map, a chronological timeline of trips, and a searchable country explorer with currency, language, and population details.
features: Dashboard with travel stats: countries visited/lived/wishlisted, total trips, days abroad, continent progress
Interactive 3D globe showing visited countries with color highlights
US states map with color-coded visited/lived/wishlisted states
Chronological trip timeline with country flags, dates, and status badges
Searchable country explorer with currency, language, population for all ~195 countries
Add/edit/delete countries and trips with form-based entry
